name: Ginger-Glazed Grilled Peaches
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 lb large peaches, peeled and halved
¼ cup crystallized ginger, finely minced

steps: Combine liquid ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat until reduced by half.
Brush peaches with melted butter and place on a medium grill until well marked, brushing with nectar mixture often.
Pour remaining glaze into large bowl and toss with peaches; serve.
